outcome: The records root has one authority: write, read, migration, reservation guards, and the by-hand recording instructions all resolve the project's configured records root, with the legacy .baton/releases read path surviving only as an explicit observable compatibility shim - so a completed release never again re-introduces a tracked legacy path or re-trips the fresh-clone gate.

exclude: renaming or revaluing the exported root constants (DefaultRecordsRoot stays .sworn/records, LegacyRecordsRoot stays .baton/releases)
the containment mask surface (.baton, .sworn and .git stay reserved for workers regardless of shim state)
relocating already-recorded history outside the sanctioned migration

consumes gitx and baton by import only; no records-root behaviour is pinned by its tests and the constants it could see are constrained unchanged

acceptance.text: With a project configured to a non-default records_root, migration relocates records into that root and every reader and reservation guard resolves the same root: pinned by a non-default-root migration case in internal/gitx/migrate_test.go and configured-root guard cases in internal/baton's record fixtures.

The legacy read fallback is explicit and observable: a record readable only at the legacy root resolves solely when the compatibility shim admits it and each firing is visible in the read state, pinned by internal/baton/legacy_fallback_test.go re-expressed against the shim; the real-binary legacy resume in test/e2e/legacy_migration_linux_test.go stays green.

No recording instruction names the legacy root as authority: AGENTS.md and the embedded operation and protocol assets direct recorders to the configured records root, with the embedded-asset digest chain regenerated - pinned by the asset verification tests in internal/baton.

The public surface agrees with the shim: the fresh-clone gate's declared-versus-executed status matches its own header claim, and the .gitattributes and CI pathspec text pinned by cmd/sworn/allowlist_invariants_test.go matches the shim state.

constraints: Exported constant names and values are unchanged; the four waived packages depend on exactly that stability.
Workers' containment view is unchanged: .baton, .sworn and .git remain reserved and masked regardless of shim state (internal/driver's immutability pins).
Legacy-era history keeps resuming: the real-binary legacy resume e2e is a hard floor, not a negotiable expectation.

Evidence basis: the engine's write fence already refuses legacy writes (NON_RECORD_CHANGE); the recurrences were authored by the by-hand procedure following doc surfaces that still name .baton/releases as authority, and a one-time migration has left 22 marker commits across refs (sworn#215).
The e2e check is declared, not executed by a role (ADR 0010).
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
